name: Ark Harrington
source:
Affiliation: Knight School
Hobby: Collecting Knives
Special Skill: Sleight of Hand
Likes: Shiny Things
Dislikes: Effort

A knight. Lute's childhood friend.
He has good skill with the sword, but he also has a bad mouth and attitude.
He himself doesn't seem to care, but he is quickly getting a bad reputation.
An overconfident person who thinks of himself a genius when he is merely talented.
He believes completely in his own sense of justice.
